Hi Sasha,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and for attaching the delegation letter. A couple items from our procurement + tax onboarding checklist to confirm before we release PO-2028-4642: 

1) Notarization / e-notary: Our default is to accept a scanned wet signature if it's accompanied by a notarization (physical or e-notary) OR a clear delegation-of-authority signed by a C-suite officer. Can you confirm whether the AP manager signature was completed via DocuSign/e-notarization or is a scanned wet signature? If DocuSign, please send the envelope ID (we can accept that in lieu of a notarization in most cases).

2) Bank letter for TIN match: If we can't do an IRS TIN match automatically, we need a bank letter confirming the business name and TIN or a cleared vendor ACH remittance (bank statement redacted). A scanned bank letter in PDF is fine — separate from the W-8.

3) Effective signer authority: your delegation_letter_signed.pdf looks good but we need one of two options: (a) a corporate resolution or (b) the delegation plus an officer’s signature (CEO/CFO) on company letterhead. The delegation you sent is close, but the signatory line is an internal HR stamp — procurement requests a named officer signature to accept delegation for tax forms.

If you can provide either: (A) DocuSign envelope ID that shows e-notary, or (B) bank letter + officer signature, we can clear the PO. Once I confirm, I'll loop in Ben to release the PO in our system.

Thanks — copying Kar to confirm policy call.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachment(s): W-8BEN-E_LuminoHealth_signed.pdf, delegation_letter_signed.pdf
